page.overview:
Who is Selame Necoine?

Selame Necoine was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year.

Selame held the position for fifty-five years until her death in the series. She was Deane Aryman's successor and Rabayn Marushta's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She failed to capitalize on Deane's earlier successes as mediator and negotiator to put an end to the Hundred Years War, and the war continued for another thirty years. Still, she was an Amyrlin of average strength.
